blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) increasingly forecast real-world events by searching the Web and reasoning over what they find. How well such an agent forecasts depends on both the retrieved evidence and the model, making control over that evidence essential for evaluation. Live evaluations can mix retrieval with reasoning when each system searches on its own, while retrospective search can leak later information through date filters or today's ranking of historical pages. Comparing models, search sources, and memory strategies requires both fixed evidence and a record of how it evolved before resolution. We introduce ForecastGym, which records what four commercial web search APIs return for open prediction-market questions every two days and replays this frozen evidence offline once outcomes are known, comparing models, memory, and captured search sources under a fixed evidence-acquisition policy. Its first release covers 150 questions, 614 evidence states, one per question and collection time, and 131k search results. Rerunning the same queries after settlement returns results that all but state the outcome for up to 92% of the questions, despite the tested date filters. On the frozen evidence, all tested LLMs trail the market in forecasting accuracy. Our diagnostic analysis suggests that missed public information contributes more to the gap in high-gap states than misreading does. Switching the search API changes a model's Brier score by up to 0.043, more than the spread across models, while persistent notes score similarly to rereading all evidence at half the input tokens. The evidence a forecaster sees can matter as much as the model that reads it.
blocks.zh: 代理商基于大型语言模型(LLMs),通过搜索Web和对发现的东西进行推理,越来越能预测现实世界的事件. 这种代理人的预测如何取决于所取取的证据和模型,使控制这些证据对评价至关重要。 活性评价可以在每个系统自行搜索时将检索与推理相混合,而回溯性搜索则可以通过日期过滤或今天的历史页面排名来泄露后期信息. 比较模型,搜索源和内存策略,既需要固定的证据,也需要记录它是如何在解析前演变的. 我们引入了"预测Gym"(PreatyGym),它记录了四个商业网络搜索API每两天返回一次公开预测-市场问题,并在结果得知后重放被冻结的证据,比较模型,内存,并根据固定的证据获取政策捕获搜索来源. 其首次发布的内容包括150个问题,614个证据状态,每个问题和收集时间各一个,以及131k搜索结果. 在结算返回后重放同样的查询结果,所有问题除说明结果外,不超过92%,尽管测试了日期过滤器。 在被冻结的证据上,所有经过测试的LLMs都跟踪市场预测准确性. 我们的诊断分析显示,错失的公共信息比误读更能造成高差距状态的差距。 切换搜索 API 将模型的 Brier 分数修改为 0.043 , 超过跨模型的分布,而持续音符的分数类似地重读了输入符中的一半的所有证据. 预测者看到的证据与读取它的模式一样重要.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en:
Forecasting tournaments have shown that trained forecasters and aggregated crowds can predict world events well ( Mellers et al., 2014 ; Tetlock and Gardner, 2015 ) , and online prediction markets such as Polymarket 1 1 1 https://polymarket.com and Kalshi 2 2 2 https://kalshi.com let participants trade contracts on such events, with prices that move as news appears on the Web.
Large language model (LLM) agents now take on a similar role ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ) , searching the Web, reasoning over what they find, and revising their probability as new information arrives.
Augmented with retrieval ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) , such systems approach the accuracy of human forecasting crowds ( Halawi et al., 2024 ; Schoenegger et al., 2024 ) , which calls for evaluating them under comparable conditions.
Crucially, a forecast depends on both the evidence behind it and the model that reads it.
Existing benchmarks follow two routes: ❶ live benchmarks collect forecasts on open questions and score them after resolution ( Karger et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , and ❷ retrospective benchmarks replay resolved questions with historical evidence ( Zou et al., 2022 ; Wildman et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Goel et al., 2026 ) , summarized in Table 1 .
blocks.zh:
预测锦标赛显示,训练有素的预报员和集合人群可以很好地预测世界事件(Mellers等,2014;Tetlock和Gardner,2015;Polymarket 1 1 1 https://polymarket.com和Kalshi 2 2 2 https://kalshi.com),让参与者就此类事件签订合同,随着新闻出现而价格变动.
大型语言模型(LLM)代理现在承担类似的角色(Hsieh等,2024;Yuan等,2025.),搜索网络,推理发现什么,并随着新信息到来而修订概率.
随着检索的增加(Lewis等,2020年),这类系统接近了人类预报人群的准确性(Halawi等,2024年;Schoenegger等,2024年),这要求它们在可比条件下进行评估.
关键的是,预测既取决于背后的证据,也取决于读取它的模式.
现有基准遵循两个途径: QQ现场基准收集未解问题的预测,并在解答后进行分数(Karger等,2025;Zeng等,2025;Yang等,2025;和XQ回顾基准,2022;Wildman等,2025;Ye等,2026;Goel等,2026;),总结于表1。

blocks.en:
Despite these advances, evaluating forecasting agents still faces four challenges.
(i) Leaky reconstruction: retrospective evaluation must recover the evidence available at time t t .
Date-filtered retrieval can admit content updated after t t ( Paleka et al., 2025a ; El Lahib et al., 2026 ) , and even historical page snapshots can be selected or ranked using today’s search index ( Wildman et al., 2025 ; Prophet Arena, 2026 ) .
Preserving old content alone therefore does not preserve what a search service would have returned then.
(ii) Entangled retrieval and reasoning: when live benchmarks let each system gather its own evidence, a score mixes what it found with how it reasoned ( Tang et al., 2026 ; Chi et al., 2026 ) .
Shared contexts can isolate model differences ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , but reproducible comparisons also require keeping the evidence fixed across later runs.
(iii) Uncontrolled evidence dynamics: evidence evolves as an event approaches, and how agents revise their beliefs as it does ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) can be compared only if they experience the same evidence trajectory.
Repeated live forecasts alone do not supply a reusable trajectory on which to vary memory while holding incoming evidence fixed.
(iv) Search-source variation: the search provider changes what an agent sees, so its effect must be separated from that of the model.
Provider comparisons on static factual tasks ( Soni et al., 2025 ; Selvam and Ghosh, 2026 ) and time-gated search tests on resolved questions ( Prophet Arena, 2026 ) motivate a further requirement: comparing sources alongside models and memory on the same prospectively recorded forecasting trajectories.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,评价预测剂仍然面临四个挑战。
(一) 精细重建:追溯性评价必须收回时间t t.
日期过滤检索可以承认t t后更新的内容(Paleka等,2025a;El Lahib等,2026),甚至历史页面快照也可以使用今天的搜索索引(Wildman等,2025;Arena先知,2026)进行选择或排名.
因此,仅保留旧内容并不能保留当时检索服务会归还的哪些内容。
(二)被纠缠的检索和推理:当活的基准让每个系统收集自己的证据时,一个分数将它发现的与它推理的方式相混合(Tang等,2026;Chi等,2026).
共同的环境可以隔离模型差异(Yang等人,2025年),但可复制的比较也要求将证据固定在后期。
(三)不受控制的证据动态:证据随着事件临近而演化出来,而代理者如何修改其信念(袁等,2025年)只有在经历相同证据轨迹时才能进行比较.
仅靠重复的现场预报无法提供可重复的轨迹,从而在固定输入的证据的同时改变内存。
(四)搜索-源变量:搜索提供者改变代理所看到的,因此其效果必须与模型的效果相分离.
提供方对静态事实任务的比较(Soni等人,2025年;Selvam和Ghosh,2026年)和对已解决问题的定时搜索测试(Arena, 2026年)促使进一步要求:将源与模型和内存比较到同一未来记录的预测轨迹上。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we introduce ForecastGym , a benchmark that treats evidence as a controlled experimental variable, as illustrated in Figure 1 .
Its key insight is simple: what a search API returns while a question is still open was knowable at that time by construction. ForecastGym enables retrospective experimentation under prospectively recorded information conditions, preserving both the evidence content and the search provider’s selection before resolution.
Figure 2 shows its two phases.
In Phase 1, Live Capture , ForecastGym queries four commercial web search APIs every two days for unresolved prediction-market questions and stores each provider’s results as a time-stamped evidence state, as detailed in Section 3.3 .
Providers share an initial query plan and follow-up policy, and their results are stored separately.
In Phase 2, Controlled Replay , agents follow the protocol in Section 3.4 to read the frozen states offline in chronological order once outcomes are known.
Replay isolates forecasting and belief revision: for a given provider, every run follows the same evidence trajectory.
The model , memory , and search source can then be varied one at a time while the other settings remain fixed, allowing score differences to be attributed to the component changed.
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了预测Gym,如图1所示,该基准将证据视为一个可控制的实验变量。
它的关键洞察力很简单:一个搜索API在问题尚未解开时返回的是什么,当时通过构建是可以理解的. 预测系统可以在预期记录的信息条件下进行追溯实验,同时保留证据内容和在解决之前选择的搜索提供者。
图2显示其两个阶段。
如第3.3节所详述,在第一阶段, " 现场捕获 " 、 " 预测Gym " 每两天就未解决的预测市场问题查询四次商业网络搜索API,并将每个供应商的结果作为时间标注的证据储存。
供应商共享初步查询计划和后续政策,其结果单独存储.
在第二阶段,控制下重放,特工们在3.4节中遵循协议,在得知结果后按时间顺序读取被冻结状态下线.
重放孤立了预测和信念修正:对于给定的提供者来说,每跑都遵循相同的证据轨迹.
然后,模型,内存,搜索源可以一次变换,而其他设置保持不变,从而可以将分数差异归因于组件被改变.

The first release contains 150 questions, 614 evidence states, each holding one question’s evidence at one collection time, and 131k search results.
The same queries rerun after settlement reveal the outcome for up to 92% of the questions despite the tested date filters.
On the frozen evidence, all tested LLMs trail the market in forecasting accuracy.
Our diagnosis of high-gap states attributes nearly three times as much of their gap to missed public information as to misreading.
Switching the search API moves the Brier score by up to 0.043, more than the spread across models, while memory mainly steadies the forecasts. The evidence a forecaster sees can matter as much as the model that reads it.

第一次发布包含150个问题,614个证据,每个问题的证据在一个收集时间持有一个问题的证据,以及131k的搜索结果.
尽管测试了日期过滤器,但在结算后再次进行同样的查询,发现多达92%的问题的结果。
在被冻结的证据上,所有经过测试的LLMs都跟踪市场预测准确性.
我们对于高差距的诊断认为,它们的差距是错读公共信息的三倍。
切换搜索API将布赖尔分数移动至0.043分,超过跨模型的分布,而内存主要稳定了预测. 预测者看到的证据与读取它的模式一样重要.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Early datasets framed event forecasting over time-restricted text: ForecastQA ( Jin et al., 2021 ) casts it as question answering, and Autocast ( Zou et al., 2022 ) pairs forecasting-tournament questions with a date-indexed news corpus.
Subsequent systems retrieve news, reason with tools, or aggregate several models to produce probabilistic forecasts ( Halawi et al., 2024 ; Hsieh et al., 2024 ; Schoenegger et al., 2024 ) .
Live benchmarks, including ForecastBench ( Karger et al., 2025 ) , FutureX ( Zeng et al., 2025 ) , and Prophet Arena ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , evaluate predictions submitted before outcomes are known, and refresh their questions to avoid contamination, as LiveBench ( White et al., 2025 ) does for general tasks.
Along the same line, Daily Oracle ( Dai et al., 2025 ) generates questions continuously from daily news, and MIRAI ( Ye et al., 2024 ) evaluates agents that query event databases.
Other work scores forecasters before resolution by testing whether their predictions on related questions agree ( Paleka et al., 2025b ) , or scores financial forecasts under trading costs ( Hu et al., 2026 ) .
Retrospective benchmarks instead provide reusable historical environments: Bench to the Future ( Wildman et al., 2025 ) supplies offline web corpora, and Hindcast ( Ye et al., 2026 ) replays prediction-market questions against a frozen Reddit archive.
Such evaluations must account for both model knowledge of resolved outcomes and the temporal validity of retrieved evidence ( Paleka et al., 2025a ; El Lahib et al., 2026 ) .
Live evaluation does not by itself provide fixed evidence for later controlled comparisons, while retrospective evaluation must preserve both historical content and the search service’s selection of it.
For example, BTF freezes page content but uses live Google search over its stored pages, leaving a possible change in ranking ( Wildman et al., 2025 ) . ForecastGym combines prospective collection with offline replay, preserving the results exactly as each provider returned them before resolution.
blocks.zh:
早期数据集在受时间限制的文本中设定了事件预测:"预测QA"(Jin等,2021年)将其设定为"问答","Autocast"(Zou等,2022年)将预测-旅游问题与日期索引新闻本体相配.
随后的系统获取新闻,有工具的理性,或聚合了几种模型来产生概率预测(Halawi等,2024;Hsieh等,2024;Schoenegger等,2024.).
活性基准,包括"预测奔驰"(Karger等,2025年),"未来X"(曾等,2025年)和"先知阿雷纳"(Yang等,2025年),评价在得知结果之前提交的预测,并重新提出问题来避免被污染,就像"预测奔驰"(White等,2025年)一般任务.
在同一条线上,"每日甲骨文"(Dai等,2025年)不断从每日新闻中产生问题,MIRAI(Ye等,2024年)评价查询事件数据库的代理商.
其他工作评分在解析前通过测试其对相关问题的预测是否一致(Paleka等,2025b),或者在交易成本下评分财务预测(Hu等,2026.
回溯基准提供了可重复使用的历史环境: Beach to the Future(Wildman等,2025年)提供离线网络公司,而Hindcast(Ye等,2026年)则针对被冻结的Reddit档案重放预测-市场问题.
这种评价必须既考虑到对已解决结果的模型了解,又考虑到收回证据的时间有效性(Paleka等人,2025年a;El Lahib等人,2026年)。
现场评价本身并不能为以后的控制性比较提供固定的证据,而追溯性评价必须保留历史内容和搜索服务的选择。
例如,BTF冻结了页面内容,但在所储存的页面上使用实时Google搜索,使得排名可能有所变化(Wildman等,2025.). 预测Gym将预期的收集与离线回放相结合,在每一个提供者在解析前返回结果时保持准确结果.

blocks.en:
Because the knowledge of language models goes stale ( Lazaridou et al., 2021 ; Liska et al., 2022 ) , questions about the current world are answered better with search, as RealTime QA ( Kasai et al., 2023 ) and FreshLLMs ( Vu et al., 2024 ) show, which makes the retrieved evidence part of what is evaluated.
Search benchmarks therefore fix it: BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2026 ) replaces live search with a curated corpus to separate retrieval from reasoning, and Deep Research Bench ( Bosse et al., 2025 ) freezes scraped pages so that agents can be compared offline.
Within forecasting, Dr-CiK ( Tang et al., 2026 ) tests retrieval of supporting context for time-series predictions, and WorldReasoner ( Chi et al., 2026 ) scores the evidence an event forecast cites.
The search provider adds its own variation: OpenHands-Versa ( Soni et al., 2025 ) succeeds on GAIA at different rates with different providers, and Selvam and Ghosh ( Selvam and Ghosh, 2026 ) find similar accuracy but unequal evidence across providers on SealQA-Hard.
Prophet Arena audits time-gated search with prospective captures, but acknowledges ranking leakage and fallible leakage detection ( Prophet Arena, 2026 ) .
Its exports omit page text, precluding exact offline replay from those exports.
Among the benchmarks in Table 1 , ForecastGym alone combines prospectively captured, provider-specific evidence trajectories with controlled offline comparisons of models and memory.
blocks.zh:
由于对语言模型的知识已经过时(Lazaridou等,2021;Liska等,2022),因此有关当前世界的问题通过搜索得到更好的答案,如RealTime QA(Kasai等,2023)和FreshLLM(Vu等,2024)显示,这使得所取出的证据成为评价的一部分.
因此,搜索基准可以固定它:浏览Comp-Plus(Chen等,2026年)将现场搜索取而代之的是一个从推理中分离检索的解析程序;而Deep Research Bench(Bosse等,2025年)冻结了被刮去的页面,以便可以将代理进行离线比较.
在预测中,CiK博士 (Tang等,2026年)测试时间序列预测的支持上下文的检索,而WorldReasoner(Chi等,2026年)将事件预测所引用的证据评分.
搜索提供者会添加自己的变体: 打开 手 - 维尔萨 (Soni等人,2025年)在GAIA上以不同的速度与不同的供应商成功,而Selvam和Ghosh(Selvam和Ghosh,2026年)在SealQA-Hard上发现供应商的相似准确性但不平等的证据.
先知阿雷纳以预期的捕捉方式进行定时的搜索,但承认排行榜的漏出和可失漏探测(先知阿雷纳,2026年).
它的出口省略了页面文本,排除了这些出口中准确的离线回放。
在表1中的基准中,仅预测Gym就结合了预期捕获的、提供方特有的证据轨迹和对模型和内存的控制下线比较。

blocks.en:
EvolveCast ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) compares forecasts revised after news updates with human revisions, for both individual and accumulated news, although its question–news associations are reconstructed retrospectively.
FutureSim ( Goel et al., 2026 ) replays a chronological news stream to study long-horizon adaptation, search, and memory.
ForecastCompass ( Chang et al., 2026 ) instead transfers experience across forecasting tasks through adaptive factor and reasoning memories, while LongMemEval ( Wu et al., 2025 ) examines retention and knowledge updates in extended conversations.
Yet the forecasting studies among them either rebuild the evidence after the fact or transfer memory across tasks, so none isolates memory on evidence captured before resolution. ForecastGym addresses this gap by holding each provider’s evidence trajectory for the same question fixed and varying only what the agent retains, so that differences in forecasts can be attributed to memory alone.
blocks.zh:
EvolveCast(Yuan等,2025年)将新闻更新后的预测与人类的修改相比,
FutureSim (Goel等, 2026年) 重放时间顺序的新闻流来研究长相的适应,搜索,和记忆.
预测Compass(Chan等,2026年)转而通过适应因素和推理记忆将经验跨过预测任务,而LongMemEval(Wu等,2025年)则在扩展对话中审查保留和知识更新.
然而,其中的预测研究要么在事实发生后重建证据,要么在任务之间转移记忆,因此没有一项研究将记忆与解析前掌握的证据隔离开来. 预测Gym通过固定每个提供者对同一问题的证据轨迹和只改变代理人保留的内容来解决这一差距,因此预测的差异只能归因于内存。

blocks.en: 3. The ForecastGym Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3个 预测基准

blocks.en: ForecastGym is built to answer one question: how does a forecast change when a single component of the forecaster changes? Section 3.1 formalizes this question and the requirements it places on the evidence, and the remaining subsections show how the two phases of Figure 2 meet them.
blocks.zh: 预测 基因构建是为了回答一个问题:预测器单个组件改变时,预测会怎样变化? 第3.1节正式规定了这一问题及其对证据的要求,其余各分节说明了图2的两个阶段如何满足这些要求。

blocks.en: 3.1. Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1. 问题的提出

blocks.en:
A forecasting agent that searches the Web combines three components: a search source that acquires evidence, a memory that carries it across time, and a model that reasons over it.
At time t t , an agent with search provider k k forecasts a binary question q q as (1) p t = f ⁡ ( q , E t ( k ) , M t − 1 ) , p_{t}=f\bigl(q,\ E^{(k)}_{t},\ M_{t-1}\bigr), where E t ( k ) E^{(k)}_{t} is the evidence that provider k k returns at time t t , M t − 1 M_{t-1} what the agent carries from earlier times, and f f the model.

Time validity: every item in E t ( k ) E^{(k)}_{t} was knowable at time t t , since otherwise the effect is measured on leaked answers. R2. blocks.en: 3.3. Live Capture
We use Polymarket and Kalshi to ground evaluation in real prediction markets, with tradable questions, observed prices as an external baseline, and platform settlements as outcomes.
blocks.zh: 我们用Polymarket 和 Kalshi 来在真实的预测市场进行实地评估, 以可交易的问题, 观察价格作为外部基线, 以及平台和解作为结果。

blocks.en:
Answers that already exist can be memorized, and a fixed question set falls behind every new model. ForecastGym supplies a common protocol for users to collect fresh binary questions closing within 14 days.
Batch size and domain quotas are configurable; this paper evaluates one budget-limited batch of 150 questions.
A model is evaluated only on batches opened after its release.
To keep questions that are still uncertain, settle unambiguously, and leave time to revise a forecast, we drop markets priced below 10% or above 90% or closing within 48 hours, and an LLM reviewer removes questions with vague rules or hard-to-verify outcomes.
Selection then balances horizon, domain, and trading activity, and keeps at most one question per real-world event, following the rules in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
已经存在的答案可以被记住,一个固定的问题集落在了每一个新模型的后面. PrepectGym提供共同协议,供用户在14天内收集新的二进制问题收尾.
批量规模和域配额是可配置的;本文评价了一组预算有限的150个问题。
一种模型仅在发布后打开的批次上进行评估。
为了保持那些仍然不确定的问题,毫不含糊地解决,并留出时间来修改预测,我们把价格低于10%或高于90%的市场降为在48小时内关闭的市场,一个LLM评论员用模糊的规则或难以核实的结果来排除问题。
选择然后平衡视野、域和交易活动,并遵循附录A的规则,每个现实世界事件最多保留一个问题。

ForecastGym collects each question’s evidence every two days until the forecast cutoff, the earliest of its deadline, the start of the event, and its settlement, so the states follow the evidence as the event approaches but never report the event itself.
Every result is stored with its source, query, and retrieval time, and a late collection is marked as missed rather than reconstructed, so Eq. ( 5 ) holds for every stored item.

预测 Gym每隔两天收集每个问题的证据,直到预测截止, 最早的截止日期, 事件的开始, 以及它的解决, 所以随着事件临近,
每个结果都与其来源,查询和检索时间一起被存储,而后期收藏被标记为被忽略而非被重建,因此Eq. (5)为所储存的每个物品所持有.

blocks.en:
At each collection time ForecastGym queries four web search APIs that stand for different ways of searching.
Serper returns Google’s ranked results, Tavily and Parallel are built for LLM agents and return page content or excerpts chosen for the query, and Exa searches its own index by meaning rather than by keywords. 3 3 3 https://serper.dev , https://tavily.com , https://parallel.ai , https://exa.ai To meet R2, an LLM writes a shared initial plan of up to four queries per collection time.
A resolution query identifies the rule and source that will settle the question; a current-evidence query retrieves the latest news.
A base-rate query asks how often similar events occur, and a counterevidence query seeks reasons the likely outcome may fail.
Where a provider’s results miss one of these needs, the LLM sends that provider up to two follow-up queries.
At each state, queries are planned during capture, independently of the forecasting models, so one recording serves every model.

在每次收集时间,预测Gym查询四个代表不同搜索方式的网络搜索API.
Serper返回Google的排名结果,Tavily和Avil是为LLM代理构建的并返回页面内容或为查询选择的节选,Exa通过意义而不是关键词搜索自己的索引. 3 3 https://serper.dev.,https://tavily.com.,https://yol.ai.,https://exa.ai. 为了与R2相会,一个LLM写了一个共享的初始计划,每个收集时间最多四个查询.
解析查询会识别解决问题的规则和源;当前证据查询会检索最新消息.
一个基率查询询问类似事件的发生频率,一个反证查询则询问可能的结果可能失败的原因.
如果提供者的结果没有满足其中一项需要, LLM会向提供者发送最多两次后续询问.
在每个状态下,在捕捉时都会计划查询,独立于预测模型,因此一个记录为每个模型服务.

blocks.en:
Outcomes are read from the platform that posed the question, and disputed or ambiguous ones are excluded.
A completed batch is frozen as a versioned snapshot, and unsettled questions are scored later without changing their evidence.

完成的批次被作为版本快照被冻结,未解决的问题在后期被打分而不改变其证据.

blocks.en: 3.4. Controlled Replay
blocks.zh: 3.4. 受控重放

blocks.en:
Controlled Replay evaluates forecasters on the frozen record offline in Phase 2 of Figure 2 , much as a trader backtests a strategy on recorded market data rather than on prices reconstructed afterwards.
The agent sees one provider’s states of a question in order, as if it were forecasting live, and forecasts each state once without calling any live service, so every run reads the same evidence and R3 holds.
blocks.zh:
在图2第2阶段,受控回放对被冻结记录的预报员进行线下评价,就像贸易商对记录的市场数据进行回放测试,而不是对事后重建的价格进行策略测试。
代理商认为一个供应商的问题状态是有序的,仿佛它正在现场预测,并且每州一次在没有呼叫任何现场服务的情况下就进行预测,所以每次运行都会读取同样的证据和R3持有.

blocks.en:
A valid state can still give a model a shortcut, so three safeguards filter it before it is shown.
Items dated later than the state, such as previews dated by an upcoming event, are hidden, and so are items that show the question’s own market price, which the model could otherwise copy.
Near-duplicates are merged, so that repeated coverage does not count as more evidence, and everything else is shown regardless of search rank.
blocks.zh:
一个有效的状态仍然可以给一个模型一个快捷键,所以在显示之前有三个保障措施过滤它.
晚于状态的项目,例如即将到来的事件的预览,是隐藏的,显示问题本身市场价格的项目也是隐藏的,模型可以复制。
相近的重复被合并,这样重复的覆盖不会算作更多的证据,其他的都显示,不管搜索级别如何.

blocks.en: 4. The First ForecastGym Release
blocks.zh: 4. 第一次预测基因释放

blocks.en:
The first batch opened on 14 September 2026 and was collected for 14 days.
It contains 150 questions, 614 evidence states and 131k search results, with two to seven states per question.
The batch targets forecasting on real prediction-market questions, with domain quotas broadening coverage across six domains within the platforms’ supply.
One question was cancelled and five await settlement, leaving 144 scored questions.
Their initial market prices score 0.215 Brier, against 0.250 for a constant forecast of 0.5, consistent with uncertainty at collection.
Appendix A reports the full statistics and scope.

批量预测真实预测市场问题,将域名配额扩大到平台供应的6个域。

他们最初的市场价格得分为0.215 Brier,而0.250的不变预测为0.5,这与收集时的不确定性是一致的.

At a question’s second state, 71% of the pooled URLs are new, and at every later state more than 40% still are.
Over its lifetime a question accumulates 374 distinct URLs on average, about three times as many as a single state holds, so a single snapshot would miss much of what became knowable.

blocks.en:
The date filter of Eq. ( 4 ) errs in two directions, and the batch shows that both are common.
Most pages carry no date and would be dropped: only 36.8% of our documents have one.
Some dates are also wrong: 6.7% of dated documents are dated after they were retrieved, typically previews and box-score pages dated by the upcoming event, whose content is later replaced by the outcome.
This matches the leakage reported for date-filtered retrieval ( El Lahib et al., 2026 ) , whereas Eq. ( 5 ) bounds every document by its retrieval time.

大部分文件没有日期,将被删除:只有36.8%的文件有一份。
有些日期也是错误的: 6.7%的已过期文件在检索后注明日期,通常为即将到来的事件所注明日期的预览和框分页,其内容后来被结果所取代.
这与报告的日期过滤检索(El Lahib等,2026年)的渗漏相匹配,而Eq. (5) 则按检索时间对每份文件进行约束。

blocks.en:
We sample 60 settled questions in proportion to the batch’s domains.
For each question’s last replay state t t , we rerun its two initial queries for current evidence and counterevidence after settlement, once raw and once with each provider’s filter for pages published before t t .
An outcome-aware LLM judge marks an item as leaking if its content carries information from after t t , whatever date the page shows.
We report Leaking, the share of leaking items, and Revealed, the share of questions whose leaking items all but state the outcome.
Gemini 3.8 Flash forecasts from the filtered and live results of the same queries; Appendix B.3 gives the filter settings.
blocks.zh:
我们抽样了60个与批量域成比例的已解决的问题。
对于每个问题的最后一次重放状态 t t, 我们重新运行两个初步的询问, 询问当前的证据和和解后的反证,
了解结果的LLM评委将某一项标为泄露,
我们报告泄漏, 泄漏物品的份额, 和揭示, 问题的份额 泄露物品的所有 说明结果。
双子座 3.8 同一查询的被过滤和活结果的闪出预报;附录B.3给出了过滤设置.

blocks.en:
All four models forecast every state in the main condition with Tavily’s evidence and once more closed-book.
We compare their scores with the market price at the same states and when collection began.
Under the blind rule , we buy $1 of the side a model favors whenever its forecast differs from the quote by more than 0.05; in the trading mode , Gemini 3.8 Flash makes its own trades with the quotes in view.
Trades fill at the recorded price plus or minus half the bid–ask spread, pay Kalshi’s fee, and are scored by profit per dollar staked, with details in Appendix B.4 .
We use outcome-aware Gemini 3.8 Flash for two distinct diagnostic labeling tasks.
Evidence-direction labeling classifies each state’s evidence as pointing toward the outcome, against it, or both ways.
For states trailing the market by more than 0.1 Brier, gap attribution identifies the fact that would have improved the forecast and checks the displayed evidence, items removed by the safeguards, and other providers’ results, as detailed in Appendix B.5 .
blocks.zh:
所有四个模型都用塔维利的证据预测每个状态,
我们比较他们的分数 与市场价格 在相同的州和 当开始收集。
在盲从规则下,我们购买1美元 一方一个模型的优惠 当它的预测 与引文不同 超过0.05; 在交易模式中,双子座 3.8 Flash 自己与引文进行交易。
交易按记录价格加上或减去一半的竞价差价,支付Kalshi的手续费,按每美元计价,详情见附录B.4。
我们使用结果感知双子座 3.8 Flash来完成两个不同的诊断标签工作.
证据指导标签将每个州的证据归为指向结果、反对结果或两种方式。
如附录B.5所详述的,对于落后于市场超过0.1布赖尔的国家来说,差距归属确定了可以改进预测和检查所显示证据、保障措施取出的物品和其他提供者的结果的事实。

blocks.en:
We track scores by days until the event and ablate memory for Gemini 3.8 Flash with Tavily’s evidence.
For each pair of consecutive states, we compare the forecast’s absolute probability change and direction with the market’s move over the same interval, as detailed in Appendix D.5 .
blocks.zh:
并用塔维利的证据来减少双子座 3.8 Flash的记忆。
如附录D.5所详述的,对于每对连续状态,我们将预测的绝对概率变化和方向与市场在同一时间段的移动进行比较。

blocks.en:
Gemini 3.8 Flash replays every state with each provider’s evidence.
To see whether the provider also reorders the models, all four forecast the last state without memory from Tavily’s evidence and from Exa’s, whose results overlap least with Tavily’s.
blocks.zh:
双子座 3.8 Flash 以每个提供者的证据重放每个状态 。
要了解提供商是否也重新订购模型,所有四家都从塔维利的证据和埃克萨的证据中预测最后一个状态,没有记忆,其结果与塔维利的结果相差最小.

blocks.en:
We evaluate four LLMs from four developers, GPT-5.6 Terra from OpenAI, Claude Sonnet 5 from Anthropic, Gemini 3.8 Flash from Google, and the open-weight DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash from DeepSeek-AI ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) .
All were released before the batch opened, as listed in Appendix B.1 , so none can have seen its outcomes.
All receive the same prompt and settings given in Appendix C .
Gemini 3.8 Flash, chosen for its speed and cost, runs the variants beyond the main comparison.
GPT-6.1 Sol, released after the batch resolved, is not ranked but checks whether a newer model closes the gap and whether knowledge of the outcomes shows in its closed-book forecasts.
blocks.zh:
我们评价4个开发商的4个LLM,GPT-5.6 Terra来自OpenAI,克洛德·索内特5来自Anthropic,双子座 3.8 由Google提供闪电,以及由DeepSeek-AI(DeepSeek-AI,2026年)提供的开放量 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.
如附录B.1所列出的,全部在批量打开前就已释放,因此无法看到结果。
所有人都收到附录C中的同样提示和设置。
双子座 3.8 Flash,以其速度和成本选择,运行的变体超出了主比较.
分批解决后发布的GPT-6.1 Sol不是排名,而是检查更新的模型是否缩小了差距,以及对其结果的了解是否显示在其封闭账本预测中.

blocks.en:
Tavily is the main provider, chosen before any forecast from properties measured without outcomes.
At collection time, the query-planning LLM rated its results highest for covering the query purposes, and they held the largest share of items relevant to the question, although it reports no publication dates, as Appendix B.2 details.
blocks.zh:
Tavily是主要提供者,在从无结果计量的属性进行预测之前被选定。
在收集时间,查询规划LLM因其涵盖查询目的而将其结果评为最高,它们拥有与该问题有关的项目的最大份额,尽管它没有报告出版日期,作为附录B.2的细节.

blocks.en:
Our primary metric is the Brier score ( p − y q ) 2 (p-y_{q})^{2} , the squared error of a forecast probability.
It is strictly proper, so a forecaster scores best in expectation by reporting its true belief ( Brier, 1950 ; Gneiting and Raftery, 2007 ) , and a constant forecast of 0.5 scores 0.25.
To score a whole trajectory, the time-averaged Brier score (TBS) averages it over the T q T_{q} scored states of a settled question q q , (7) TBS q = 1 T q ​ ∑ t ( p q , t − y q ) 2 , \mathrm{TBS}_{q}=\frac{1}{T_{q}}\sum_{t}\bigl(p_{q,t}-y_{q}\bigr)^{2}, and the mean TBS or the mean last-state Brier score over questions serves as the score ℒ \mathcal{L} of Eq. ( 3 ).
The last state is the latest before the forecast cutoff.
Accuracy is the share of last-state forecasts on the correct side of 0.5, counting a forecast of exactly 0.5 as half.
The market price at each state, the platform’s latest price at or before the replay time, serves as an external baseline, since traders are not limited to the recorded evidence.
Differences are paired by question, averaging over a question’s states first, and come with 95% bootstrap intervals obtained by resampling questions.
We call a difference significant when its interval excludes zero, and compare model rankings with Kendall’s τ \tau .

blocks.en: 6. Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结果和分析

blocks.en: Sections 6.1 , 6.2 , 6.3 , and 6.4 address RQ1–RQ4, respectively.
Table 3. Post-hoc search on 60 settled questions, with raw and date-filtered results. ∗ Significantly below the live snapshot.
blocks.zh: 页:1 3. 对60个已解决的问题进行事后搜索,结果为原始和被过滤的日期。 * 显著低于现场快照。

blocks.en: 6.1. Post-hoc Search Leaks the Outcome
blocks.zh: 6.1. 事后搜索漏出结果

blocks.en:
As Table 3 shows, the date-filtered evidence of Eq. ( 4 ) still leaks for every provider, and each fails in its own way.
Tavily attaches no dates to its results, so its filter cannot be audited at all.
Exa’s filter removes every result it dates after t t but passes the 61% of results it leaves undated, and Serper’s still returns 12% of results dated after t t .
The leaking items are mostly final scores, earnings releases, and product changelogs, while the judge flags few live results, providing a check on false alarms.
blocks.zh:
如表3所显示,Eq. (4)被过滤出的证据对于每个提供者来说仍然漏出,每个提供者都以自己的方式失败.
Tavily没有将日期附在结果上,因此其过滤器完全无法被审计.
Exa的过滤器移除了在 t t 之后的每一个结果,但通过它留下的61%的结果没有日期,Serper仍然返回了 t t 之后的12%的结果。
被泄露的物品大多是最终分数,收入释放,以及产品变更日志,而法官所标注的活出结果很少,提供了对假警报的检查.

blocks.en:
Forecasting from Tavily’s or Exa’s filtered results, Gemini scores 0.137 and 0.080 Brier, far better than any model or even the market does on live evidence in Table 4 .
The tested date filters thus leave post-hoc evidence temporally unreliable, motivating capture before resolution, as in the remaining experiments.
blocks.zh:
根据Tavily或Exa过滤结果的预测,双子座得分为0.137和0.080 Brier,远胜过表4中任何模型甚至市场的实际证据。
因此,经过测试的日期过滤器使浩克后的证据在时间上不可靠,促使在解析之前捕获,如在剩余的实验中。

blocks.en: 6.2. Models Trail the Market
blocks.zh: 6.2. 市场障碍模式

blocks.en: 6.2.1. Model Differences Are Small
blocks.zh: 6.2.1. 模型差异 是个小的

blocks.en: Table 4. Main condition with Tavily’s evidence, at each question’s last state. Gap: to the market over all states, significant for all. † Released after the batch resolved.
blocks.zh: 表4. 每个问题最后状态下Tavily证据的主要条件。 差距:面向所有各州的市场,对所有国家都是巨大的差距。 * 批次解决后释放。

blocks.en: Table 4 gives the results, and the closed-book scores show what the evidence adds, which can be negative ( Tang et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 表4给出了结果,封闭账分数显示出证据所添加的,可能是负值(Tang等,2026;Ye等,2026.).

blocks.en:
Score differences among GPT-5.6 Terra, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash are not significant, and accuracy orders them differently than the Brier score does.
Only Claude Sonnet 5 falls clearly behind, through overconfidence at the low end: its forecasts near 0.05 came true 38% of the time, and in Figure 10 c it took undated pages about a 2018 win for the upcoming match.
All models lean on the newest evidence, as 92–95% of the items they cite were first retrieved at the latest state.
GPT-6.1 Sol, released after every question had settled, is within noise of the top three, and its closed-book score shows no sign of knowing the outcomes.
blocks.zh:
GPT-5.6 Terra,双子座 3.8 Flash,和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash之间的分数差异并不显著,准确度对分数的排序与Brier分数不同.
只有克洛德·索内特(Claude Sonnet 5)明显落后,通过对低端的过度自信:它的预测接近0.05实现了38%的时间,在图10c中,它花了未注明日期的几页时间,为即将到来的比赛赢得了2018年的胜利.
所有模型都依靠最新证据,因为所引用的92%-95%的物品都是在最晚的状态下首次取回的.
GPT-6.1 Sol在每一个问题解决后发布,在前三名的噪音范围内,其闭账分数没有显示知道结果.

blocks.en: Without it, no model beats a constant forecast of 0.5, so background knowledge does not suffice, and with it every model improves, significantly so for GPT-5.6 Terra and Gemini.
blocks.zh: 没有它,任何模型都比起0.5的常数预测,所以背景知识是不够的,并且随着它,每个模型都有所改进,对于GPT-5.6 Terra和双子座来说,显著如此.

blocks.en:
Every model trails the market at the last state and over the full trajectory.
Excluding the 216 states priced at a bid–ask midpoint leaves the gap unchanged.
Nor does combining models close it: their mean is no better than the best single model, and even a blend weighted toward the market falls short of the market alone, as shown in Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh:
每个模型都会在最后的状态 和整个轨迹上追踪市场
不包括投标时定价的216个州 -- -- 任务中点 -- -- 使差距保持不变。
综合模型也没有关闭它:如附录D.1所示,它们的平均值并不比最好的单一模型好,甚至一种向市场加权的混合物也不足以单靠市场。

blocks.en:
A forecaster that trails the market could still profit if it knew when the market was wrong, as tested in Appendix D.2 .
Under the blind rule, every model loses money when it sells at the next state, significantly for three of the four, since prices tend to move away from a model that disagrees with them, and holding to settlement only shrinks the loss.
In the trading mode, Gemini keeps about half of its disagreement with the market, which improves its Brier score by 0.018 but leaves it 0.010 behind, and its trades make no significant profit.
These comparisons favor reporting intervals and the market price beside model scores.
blocks.zh:
如附录D.2所测试的那样,追踪市场情况的预报员如果知道市场何时出错,仍可获利。
在盲目规则下,每个模型在下个州发售时会输钱,对四人中的三人来说是显著的,因为价格往往会从一个与它们有分歧的模型转移,而持有和解只会收缩损失.
在交易模式下,双子座保留了大约一半的与市场的分歧,市场将它的布赖尔得分提高了0.018分,但留下了0.010分后,而其交易没有获得显著利润.
这些比较有利于报告间隔和模型分数之外的市场价格。

blocks.en: 6.2.2. The Gap Diagnosis Points Mainly to Missing Information
blocks.zh: 6.2.2. 差距诊断主要指缺失的信息

blocks.en: Figure 5. Where the models’ Brier gap to the market lies. Panel a shows shares of the gap by question type against each type’s share of states; panel b shows causes across the 111 states trailing the market by more than 0.1, drawn from 49 questions.
blocks.zh: 图5. 模式在哪里 布里尔与市场的差距是谎言。 小组a显示按问题类型分列的差距与每一类型国家的比例的比例;小组b显示从49个问题中抽取的111个落后于市场的州的原因超过0.1个。

blocks.en:
Sports match winners, spreads, and totals make up more than half the states, and the models come within 0.004 Brier of the market on these questions.
Figure 5 a shows that almost all of the gap lies in other domains and culture questions, such as album sales, review scores, and awards.
blocks.zh:
体育比赛的优胜者,分布,总计占全州半数以上,赛车型在0.004以内. 这些问题的市场布赖尔.
图5 a显示,几乎所有差距都存在于其他领域和文化问题,如专辑销售、评论分数和奖项。

blocks.en:
A Murphy decomposition separates calibration, whether events forecast at 70% occur 70% of the time, from resolution, the ability to give different probabilities to questions that resolve differently.
The mean of the four models is as well calibrated as the market and spreads its forecasts as widely, but its resolution is only about half the market’s.
This shortfall in resolution is consistent with the missing-information diagnosis below.
blocks.zh:
一个墨菲分解将校正,即预测的70%的事件是否在70%的时间里发生,与分辨率,给出不同概率的能力,以不同的方式解决问题.
这四种模式的平均值与市场一样精准,并广为传播其预测,但其分辨率仅为市场的一半左右.
解决的这一不足与下文的缺失信息诊断是一致的。

blocks.en:
Evidence-direction labeling characterizes each state’s evidence, as detailed in Appendix D.3 .
Where the evidence points toward the outcome, the models slightly beat the market, and only 12–17% of each model’s forecasts on the wrong side of 0.5 fall on such evidence, against 22% for the market.
The whole gap thus arises where the evidence is mixed or points the wrong way, and it is concentrated: the 19% of states in which the models trail the market by more than 0.1 Brier account for more than all of it.
blocks.zh:
如附录D.3所详述的,证据指导标签是每个州证据的特点。
当有证据表明结果时,模型略微地比市场好,每个模型的预测中只有12-17 % 的投向错误的一面,其中0.5 投向错误的一面,而市场为22 % 。
因此,当证据混杂或指错方向时,就会产生整个差距,而这种差距是集中的:模型跟踪市场超过0.1 Brier的19%的州占了全部州的比重。

blocks.en:
For these states across all four question types, gap attribution assigns each state one of four causes in Figure 5 b. Misread: the models saw the fact but misweighted it, a small share.
Every model read, for instance, that the Panama Canal’s caps allowed at most 226 transits in a week that needed more than 225, yet three put 0.43 to 0.60 on it, against the market’s 0.06. Not retrieved: the fact was public but missing from the evidence, mostly because another provider returned it or the query-planning LLM never searched for it.
This is the largest cause. Outside indexed text: the signal lived in sales tracking, streaming counts, or data dashboards.
For one album, every provider returned projections of at most 46,000 first-week units, while the market priced more than 50,000 at 0.99, and it opened with 61,000. Unknowable: nothing public pointed to the outcome, and the market itself was unsure.
The judge identified no indexing-delay cases.
blocks.zh:
对于所有四个问题类型中的这些州,差距归属在图5b中指定了四个原因中的一个。 误读:模特们看到了事实,却误重了它,只是一小部分.
例如,每个模型都读到,巴拿马运河的封顶在一周内最多允许226次需要225次以上的过境,然而,有3次将0.43至0.60次的转运,而市价为0.06。 未取回:事实公开,但证据中缺失,主要是因为另一家供应商退回,或查询规划LLM从未搜索过。
这是最大的原因。 外部索引文本:信号活在销售追踪,流出计数,或数据仪表板上.
对于一张专辑,每个提供商都以最多46000个首周单元的出价返回了预测,而市场价格则以0.99的出价超过5万张,并以61000开张. 不可知:没有公众指出结果,市场本身也不确定.
法官没有发现索引延误案件。

blocks.en:
The judge attributes nearly three times as much of the gap in these states to missed public information as to misreading.
These diagnoses can guide query design for future live batches; RQ3 and RQ4 examine memory and the captured sources.
blocks.zh:
法官认为这些州的差距几乎是错失公共信息和误读的三倍。
这些诊断可以指导未来活批量的查询设计;RQ3和RQ4检查内存和被捕获的来源.

blocks.en: 6.3. Forecasts Do Not Sharpen, and Memory Steadies Them
blocks.zh: 6.3. 预测不尖锐和记忆 他们

blocks.en: Figure 6. Brier score by days until the event in the main condition with Tavily’s evidence. Dashed: closed-book. † Released after the batch resolved.
blocks.zh: 图6. Brier根据Tavily的证据,在主要情况发生之前,他按天数得分。 折叠:已关闭。

blocks.en:
As Figure 6 shows, the evidence keeps each model well below its closed-book score at every horizon, but the scores stay roughly flat as the event approaches, and the market leads every model throughout, consistent with the missing signals identified in Section 6.2.2 .
The models instead converge on one another, disagreeing less in the last days than a week before, as shown in Appendix D.4 .
Every model also scores better on 10–14-day than on 2–5-day questions, by 0.057 for Gemini, though with only 21 short-horizon questions this may reflect their composition.
blocks.zh:
如图6所示,证据使每个模型在每一个地平线上都远低于其闭帐分数,但随着事件临近,分数大致保持平平,市场在整个过程中领导着每个模型,这与第6.2.2节所查明的缺失信号一致.
如附录D.4所示,这些模型相互趋同,最后几天的分歧少于一周前。

Rereading all evidence scores about as well as keeping notes but reads twice the input, 19.5M tokens per replay against 9.5M.
Searching the same pool with BM25 is the only alternative significantly worse in both metrics, and its forecasts differ from rereading by 0.057 on average, in line with the weakness of BM25 in controlled search benchmarks ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
Steadiness has a cost when the notes carry a wrong reading forward: for Norges Bank’s September decision in Figure 10 a, all four models drifted down as their notes stressed softer inflation, while the market rose and the bank hiked.

blocks.en: 7. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 结论

blocks.en:
ForecastGym provides a reusable protocol for prospectively recording search evidence and replaying it to compare forecasting models, memory strategies, and search sources.
The first batch shows that the tested date filters leave substantial leakage and that source differences can exceed model differences in accuracy.
All tested models trail the market, and our diagnosis attributes more of the gap in high-gap states to missed public information than to misreading.
Persistent notes steady forecasts with less input than rereading, but errors can carry forward as evidence changes.
blocks.zh:
TreatyGym提供了一个可再用的协议,用于未来记录搜索证据并重放,以比较预测模型,内存策略和搜索源.
第一批显示被测试的日期过滤器留下了大量的渗出,而源差可以超过模型的精度差异.
所有测试过的模型都跟随市场, 我们的诊断将高差距状态中的空白 归结为错失公共信息而不是误读。
持续地注意稳定的预测,投入比再读少,但错误可以随着证据的变化而继续.

blocks.en:
These findings motivate improving both evidence acquisition and belief revision.
Frozen batches support controlled comparisons on recorded evidence, while new query policies require fresh live collection.
The shared collection protocol makes these studies repeatable on fresh questions as models and search policies evolve.
blocks.zh:
这些调查结果促使改进证据获取和信念修订工作。
被冻结的批次支持对记录的证据进行有控制的比较,而新的查询政策则需要新鲜的活集.
共享的收集协议使得这些研究随着模型和搜索政策的发展而可以在新问题上重复.

blocks.en:

blocks.en: Figure 10. Three case questions, all resolved Yes. Forecasts at each state (main condition, Tavily) and the market in red on (a) Norges Bank’s hike, (b) a Metascore above 90, and (c) the Eagles beating the Titans. Three small line plots of the four models' forecasts and the market price over the evidence states of three questions.
blocks.zh: 图10 三个案子的问题,都解决了 是 每个州(主要条件,Tavily)的预测和红色市场(a) Norges银行的出行,(b) 90多分的Metascore,(c) 鹰击巨人。 四个模型预测的三个小线块 和市场价格 超过证据 三个问题。

blocks.en:
Figure 10 traces three questions chosen by fixed rules: (a) the largest miss shared by all models while the market was right, (b) the largest update toward the outcome, and (c) the largest gap between two models’ updates.
Together they mark the boundaries of what live evidence can do.
In (a), the notes kept stressing softer inflation, so memory held the models on a wrong reading while the market rose, as Section 6 discusses.
In (b), Metascores above the threshold appeared the day after release, and the models rose sharply within one state while the market stayed below 0.5.
The decisive signal was published on the Web as soon as it existed, so retrieval put every model ahead of the market, the reverse of the usual gap.
In (c), three models read the same evidence correctly, so the error lies in one model’s reading of undated pages rather than in retrieval, and it vanished at the next state.
blocks.zh:
图10记录了根据固定规则选择的三个问题:(a) 所有模型在市场正确时共用的最大错失,(b) 实现结果的最大更新,(c) 两个模型更新的最大差距。
它们共同标出活证据所能做的界限.
在(a)中,注解一直强调更软的通货膨胀,因此记忆使模型在市场崛起时被错误地读取,正如第6节所讨论.
在(b)中,超过阈值的Metascores在发行后第二天出现,模型在一个州内急剧上升,而市场保持在0.5以下.
决定性信号一出即被公布在网络上,因此检索将每一个模型都放在了市场前,即倒置了通常的缺口.
在(c)中,三个模型正确读取了同样的证据,因此错误在于一个模型读取了未注明日期的页面,而不是检索,在下一个状态中消失。
